source_scope: Additive START/current tracking and lifecycle capability
Typed P04 native P03 SAVE/CANCEL/RECORD evidence, P05/P03 and linked P03 receipts
P07 successful confirmation from exact durable native receipt
Explicit drain mode without legacy backfill
Fail-closed protection for already tracked families if both flags are disabled
Exact SAVE receipt identity and non-202 completion required at close-check and END

payload.data.tracking_contract: Persisted p14-shift-v1 or null; never backfilled
payload.data.lifecycle.end_supported: Protocol availability only; ACTIVE, tracked and enabled/draining. Never equivalent to can_end or local CLEAN.
payload.current_without_shift: data remains null; no synthetic shift
payload.close_check: Existing p14-shift-v1; additive actor_id/auth_session_id. GET is read-only and rejects body data; existing empty JSON []/{} envelopes remain accepted.
payload.end: Existing receipt remains directly at data. New receipts add actor_id. Historical stored receipts are returned unchanged.

owners.P04: Typed inbound uses its existing P03 row, form.p04_contract and exact native receipt. No duplicate snapshot; typed RECORD contributes one business ID to INBOUND.
owners.P04_record_request: POST /api/v1/mini-app/inbound/drafts/{id}/record sends warehouse_id and scan_session_id, plus optional client_request_id matching Idempotency-Key. Do not send SAVE items/metadata; the owner reads its persisted snapshot. Keep native If-Match and request identity.
owners.close_check_receipt: A DRAFT snapshot requires its exact actor/auth-session/warehouse/document/scan-session/operation/last-request/version SAVE receipt with final 2xx other than 202. Another command or scan family is not SAVE proof. Missing proof blocks END without changing the draft or journal.
owners.P05: Existing outbound P03 SAVE and source-linked RECORD unchanged. No invented typed SAVE route.
owners.P07: Successful PATCH confirm requires idempotency_keys done, canonical v2 request hash, exact actor/session/warehouse/item/tag and stored confirmation. It is not a draft or quantity/Post evidence.
owners.audit: WORK_SHIFT_OWNER_VERIFIED stores receipt identity/hash and scope, never raw form/code/password/access/refresh/reservation/written payload. Native receipt remains authoritative.
owners.202_and_old_unsupported: Remain PENDING_OWNER_RESULT/UNSUPPORTED_OWNER_SAVE blockers. No automatic journal resolution, deletion or synthetic negative outcome. Future async adapters require exact owner evidence integration.
owners.unreviewed_owners: Existing guards remain; this revision is NOT complete coverage of all Mini App writers, uploads or hardware side effects.

headers.owner: X-Work-Shift-ID and stable X-Request-ID plus original native Idempotency-Key/If-Match/X-Draft-* and contract headers.
headers.conflict: Changing native identity with the same shift request ID is SHIFT_REQUEST_CONFLICT. Rotating trace or ca does not bypass a tracked identical native intent; use owner GET.
headers.end: Only its own Idempotency-Key, If-Match and existing body. Timeout remains CHECK_ONLY using original END key.

drain.precedence: Drain wins over admission, including when both flags are true.
drain.new_start: 503 SHIFT_START_PAUSED before creating a shift or start key. Existing START keys still return their own historical shift.
drain.fence: With shift_enabled=false and drain=true, known tracked login families remain fenced, including after END even if client strips headers. Other login families are not implicitly enrolled.
drain.both_flags_off: Already tracked active or ended login families remain fenced: missing headers=428; identified owner writes=503 P14_SHIFT_NOT_ENABLED. Close-check/END remain unavailable, not auto-enabled. Existing owner GET receipts remain readable. No conversion to untracked work. Untracked/legacy families keep existing behavior. Restore approved ENABLED/DRAINING configuration to complete reconciliation; this code does not change live flags.
drain.closure: Close-check/END/reconcile/summary stay available under normal rights/scope/blockers. Drain does not authorize legacy END or UNKNOWN cleanup.
drain.check_invalidation: Changing mode requires a fresh close-check. Previously committed END receipts remain replayable under the same original identity.
drain.rollout: Do not change live flags from this source delivery. An approved operator applies configuration consistently across workers; no single-account canary is provided.
drain.rollback: First stop admission with drain enabled while retaining source/schema/receipts and owner reconciliation. Finish or explicitly resolve tracked ACTIVE/UNKNOWN work before disabling both flags. Do not revert to old non-drain code while draining.

kpis.recorded_documents: Distinct canonical business IDs on explicit supported RECORD routes, including typed P04

retained_boundaries: No legacy shift upgrade or administrative closure
No flag activation, deployment, real DB seed or migration
No claims of hardware E2E, FE wiring, whole-repository CI or live acceptance

tests.integrity: Copy and verify every tracked file from the clean exact-SHA checkout, including export-ignore files; preserve full SHA256 check after tests. No skipped missing-file verification.
tests.test_memory: 512M only in the disposable PHP CI image; no production PHP configuration change.
tests.result: Read exact commit workflow; no predicted PASS
